title: Clockwork Quest
pitch: Guide an animated clockwork explorer through three tiny rooms, solve switch puzzles and rescue a trapped companion.
capabilities: Lighting, camera composition and Rive character face
rules: Tap/click destinations or use movement controls. Three rooms form a compact complete adventure with keys and switches.
Navigation uses authored walkable regions; no giant open world. A clear interact command is separate from move.
Companion rescue is the ending. No combat, inventory grinding or procedural quest generator.
content: Three diorama rooms, six interactions, two path puzzles and one companion rescue sequence.

actions.xr: Ray-select floor destination; player is the miniature character

rive.role: Expressive face textures on stylized characters plus dialogue cards; body locomotion stays Babylon/glTF.

polish: Clear walkable boundaries and friendly path indicator
Body animation follows movement without controlling collision
Dialogue readable on phone and world panel in XR
tests: Unreachable destination gets feedback without endless path retries.
Interaction cannot activate through a closed wall.
Room transition retains inventory exactly once.
Rive face is not treated as 3D skeletal animation.
Save during dialogue restores branch and speaker.
XR entry preserves current path/room and resumes only on confirmation.
loop: validate move/interact against current room graph
advance character navigation and puzzle state
update dialogue and Rive faces from committed state
save: Exact logical adventure state; animations are reconstructed from locomotion/dialogue state.
xr_presentation: The adventure becomes a spatial diorama with ray-to-move; AR placement or virtual VR stand.
comfort: Player controls the character, never the headset camera. Every room remains reachable from a seated view.
documentKind: Exact logical adventure state; animations are reconstructed from locomotion/dialogue state.
